notes.title: Rusty Lake: Paradise is 66% OFF in our Rusty Lake Anniversary Sale ✨
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/85101fe90af9f7530ffd1c19793018841c016d64.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake![/h3] 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:

[list]
[*] [b]A new free-to-play game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show [/b]- hat tricks, sleight of hand, and a few unexpected reveals you don’t want to miss; 
[*] An early look at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]premium Rusty Lake game[/url]
[*] And special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult, including [b]a re-release of the iconic [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct]Paradox Comic Book[/url][/b] - available to pre-order right now;
[*] A week-long platform-wide discounts of up to[b] 66% OFF on all our premium games[/b], including hosting our very own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale]Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale Page[/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylakepublishersale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31319310/65fab6be9ef4a207bc012efb6c83754df59416b9.png[/img][/url]

Of course, the sale includes [b]Rusty Lake: Paradise[/b], which you can now download and play for [b]66% off[/b]! Travel back to the mystical island of Paradise!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/435120/Rusty_Lake_Hotel/

And don't forget to check out our [b]new magical puzzle game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show[/b]. A free-to-play short but magical game filled with enough secrets and unexpected twists to put you in a celebratory mood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472550/The_Mr_Rabbit_Magic_Show/

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]Wishlist now[/url] to stay up to date!

[url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct-awfzj-6r6yf-fjy72][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png[/img][/url]

As a special thank-you for your continued support over the past 10 years, we’re excited to further delight you with some special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult available to pre-order as of April 30th:

[list]
[*] 🎵 Rusty Lake: [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection[/url] - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar. 
[*] 🃏 A mysterious [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]deck of cards[/url] (perfect for your own magic tricks) - designed by Maarten Pelders, inspired by the series’ surreal symbols and characters.
[*] 📖 A re-launch of our fan-favourite [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct]Paradox Comic Book[/url] by Lau Kwong Shing.
[/list]
Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team! 

Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.

notes.title: Rusty Lake Paradise is Now 44% OFF | More updates from The Lake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31319310/0fde4d536e93153a464c15727bcfc02b6c910ee0.png[/img]

Hey everyone! All our premium games are now on sale in the SteamSummerSale for 44% OFF!  And to make the summer sale even better, our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]Rusty Lake Bundle[/url] is 52% OFF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/744190/Rusty_Lake_Paradise/

And with the sale, we bring forth some insights into our plans at Rusty Lake:

[h3]Physical Escape Room[/h3]

Lately, we have been very busy with our first physical escape room: Rusty Lake’s Black Cube Exhibition which went live during TwitchCon Rotterdam. The experience turned out to be a huge success, so we hope to bring it to other future conventions, if possible.  Read more on our [url=https://blog.rustylake.com/our-first-physical-went-live-at-twitchcon/]blog[/url]!

[h3]Rusty Lake Untold[/h3]

For the past 2 years, we’ve also been working on our first pen & paper, tabletop, escape room: Rusty Lake Untold. We are thrilled to release our first adventure: The Lab for free later this month: on July 24! Make sure to sign up [url=https://www.rustylakeuntold.com/]here[/url] and read how to play.

[h3]Follow the meaning[/h3]

We are also collaborating with Hiking Mind studio to release their debut title Follow the meaning through our publishing platform: Second Maze. The game is a premium point-and-click adventure with beautiful graphics and playtime of around 1.5 hours. They aim to release in Q3 and we think a lot of people who enjoy Rusty Lake will also enjoy this adventure so make sure to wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/  

Of course, we are also working on new game projects, but unfortunately, we cannot share anything about those plans just yet!

Stay tuned!

PS. All our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/secondmaze]Second Maze games[/url] are also 44% OFF in the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: The Past Within + Rusty Lake Midweek Madness
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce our upcoming title The Past Within:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/ 

Are you ready to unlock The Past Within? Teaming up with a friend, travel through both past and future to piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives!

Official teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=bopzNbExy1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Past Within is an upcoming multiplayer point-and-click adventure taking place in the Rusty Lake universe. Next to PC & Mac, the game is also coming to IOS, Android and hopefully console!

Please keep in mind that the development of this game is still in an early stage: we still have a long way to go before we can communicate a release date! Stay tuned on our social media, our blog or on Steam for more information / development logs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/7eb60367c1a92592a8c6307e44c5802491354ec5.png[/img][/url]

Together with this big announcement and the 5 year anniversary of our first premium game released on Steam, Rusty Lake: Hotel, we’d like to celebrate alongside all of you with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake]50% discount on all of our Steam games[/url]! Thank you for all your love and support, we wouldn’t be here without all of you wishlisting, reviewing and sharing your enthusiasm for our games on Steam!

Thank you all for your support, stay safe and greetings from The Lake!

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

notes.title: Get Prison Architect, Shantae, Nex Machina, and more in the latest Humble Bundle
notes.content:
The Humble Very Positive Bundle 3 is so named not because all the games in it are chipper and upbeat, but because they all have "very positive" user review rankings on Steam. And at least one of the games on offer is definitely not a cheery experience: Rusty Lake Paradise, which is included along with Distraint 2 and Unexplored at the entry-level $1 tier, is a wonderfully bizarre, creepy-as-hell experience, but I assure you that it is not going to brighten your day.

At the beat-the-average price, you'll add Bendy and the Ink Machine, the excellent Prison Architect, and the also-excellent Nex Machina to the list. The top tier, at $10, adds Shantae: Half-Genie Hero, which we haven't reviewed but PC Gamer Sweden liked quite a bit.

The bundle also includes the Distraint 2 and Unexplored soundtracks, and ten percent off your first Humble Monthly Bundle, if you're new to that. Your mileage may vary, but I'd say that Rusty Lake Paradise, Prison Architect, and Nex Machina are each worth the price of their respective tiers all on their own, so even though this isn't the highest-profile bundle of all time, it's still a pretty good way to blow a tenner. The Humble Very Positive Bundle 3 is up for grabs until July 30.

notes.title: Rusty Lake talk Rusty Lake, Twin Peaks,and making money from properly free games
notes.content:
The Rusty Lake universe absolutely fascinates me. Consisting of nine free room escape oddities, and three longer premium puzzling adventures, each adds clues and confusion to a deeply creepy and unsettling mystery surrounding the eponymous lake. With the recent release of the superb Rusty Lake Paradise, I wanted to speak to the two-man development team to find out how it got started, where it’s going, and how they’ve managed to keep going while making so many properly free games. So I did.

(more…)

notes.title: Wot I Think: The bloody creepy Rusty Lake Paradise
notes.content:
The long-running saga of Rusty Lake continues in Rusty Lake: Paradise, and I’m pleased to report this is one of its finest outings. I wasn’t sure at first, but by the end I was deeply embroiled in its Lynchian psychic dystopia, once more tangentially exploring the lives of a creepy family, crow-faced creatures, and that fuzzy black man-thing that haunts my dreams.

notes.title: The glorious day of The Lake has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31319310/6c3008ef6ac1d582dd7cc9dc8196d2b6aa9a2717.png[/img]

[h1]Rusty Lake Paradise is now available on Steam![/h1]

We probably lost you already...but below you can find a recap of the journey and a big thanks to all who helped us!

We always forget how much work there is in the last weeks before release. We literally spent our last weeks as cave man, finalizing the game as perfect as it can be and now it’s finally released worldwide! The last 10 months has been an incredible ride with lots of ups and downs. This is by far the most ambitious and difficult game we ever made.. 

It started with a small idea back in March, but it became a way bigger project than we thought. Changing the gameplay, choosing an island as environment, incorporating the ten plagues as a theme for each level, creating the overall storyline, making the connections with the family members and the protagonist, linking it with the overal Rusty Lake narrative, creating more than 100 puzzles and 50 achievements… this is just a small overview of what we have been doing and it was all a very big challenge. We couldn’t have done with the help of others. You all know we are just two guys, but luckily we had the help of other amazing artists, this week we already mentioned it..but Johan Scherft did an incredible job for Paradise, without his paintings for the plagues and island the game wouldn’t have the same feeling. The same counts for Victor Butzelaar’s soundtracks, each plague and level has its own theme, which brings the whole atmosphere of the game to another level (soundtrack will be available later today). Thymo Boog, a fellow Dutch sounddesign guy, who helped us with dozens of sounds, from a walking praying mantis to a screaming goat. And then there is Bob Rafferty, more than ever his powerful voice acting is part of the game, he made more than 200 takes for all the voices and next to this he helped with the trailers & walkthroughs. Can’t wait to share a blogpost about all the audio work soon.

We also want to thank all the 12 translators, you guys have been a great help with both translating and testing the game, these people make it possible to release our work worldwide and we are happy they just keep supporting us during last 4 games, amazing job. And of course (as cliche as it sounds) thanks to our family & friends who tested the game beforehand.

Most of all we want thank you guys for your ongoing support! We always think back to the first Cube Escape releases, when we just had 200 followers on social media and there was nothing to worry about. We never imagined the Rusty lake universe would grow so big! This is something we dreamt off starting Rusty Lake, thanks guys for staying with us! 
In the end we can say we are really proud what Paradise has become! 

Enjoy! It’s time!

Robin & Maarten

Ps. We really really appreciate your feedback, please leave a review in the store. A lot of times we receive emails for glitches, make sure to check out the walkthrough first, if doesn’t match email us with the issue, reset the level and try again.
Ps2. Let us know if you found the 50 secret achievements!
ps3. Soon, very soon, we will start working on a new exciting project, the plans are ready, the script is ready….

notes.title: Rusty Lake Paradise trailer teases a weird adventure about the Plagues of Egypt and your mom
notes.content:
The team behind the bizarre, creepy Rusty Lake games has announced that a new addition to the series, Rusty Lake Paradise, will be released next week. The game will follow the story of a young man named Jakob, who returns to his home of Paradise Island after the death of his mother leaves it cursed by the ten Plagues of Egypt. 

The Steam listing doesn't say much about the game beyond describing it as a "premium point-and-click adventure," in which Jakob must discover his mother's hidden memories and take part in strange family rituals in order to bring the plagues to a halt. "Each plague brings its own atmosphere, suspense and a variety of Rusty Lake brain teasers," and features its own theme song, with backdrops by Dutch painter Johan Scherft. 

The description is a little strange but it's got nothing on the trailer, which is flat-out weird, and not in the happy-trippy way of something like Samorost 3: There was a deeply sinister edge to Rusty Lake Hotel (not to mention violence), and Rusty Lake Paradise quite clearly promises more of the same.   

Mystery and secrets are a big part of what makes Rusty Lake work so you won't find much about the new game, but more information about the studio that makes it and its other games are up at rustylake.com.
